recipes.title: Ein gedimmtes Wegelicht zum Bad bei Nacht
recipes.yaml:
alias: Nachtlicht zum Bad
mode: restart
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.hallway_motion
    to: "on"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    after: "23:00:00"
    before: "06:00:00"
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.bathroom_path
    data:
      brightness_pct: 8
      color_temp_kelvin: 2200
  - wait_for_trigger:
      - trigger: state
        entity_id: binary_sensor.hallway_motion
        to: "off"
        for:
          seconds: 90
    timeout: "00:10:00"
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: light.bathroom_path

recipes.title: Die Lampe geht an, wenn es im Raum dunkel wird
recipes.yaml:
alias: Wohnzimmerlampe bei Dunkelheit
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.living_room_illuminance
    below: 40
    for:
      minutes: 5
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.living_room_presence
    state: "on"
  - condition: time
    after: "08:00:00"
    before: "22:00:00"
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.living_room_lamp
    data:
      brightness_pct: 60

recipes.title: Ein Knopf schaltet die Abendlichter aus
recipes.yaml:
alias: Flur-Taster - Abendlichter aus
triggers:
  - trigger: event.received
    target:
      entity_id: event.hall_button
    options:
      event_type:
        - single_press
actions:
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      label_id: goodnight_lights

recipes.title: Das Vorratslicht folgt der Tür
recipes.yaml:
alias: Vorratslicht folgt der Tür
mode: restart
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.pantry_door
    to: "on"
    id: opened
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.pantry_door
    to: "off"
    id: closed
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.pantry_door
    to: "on"
    for:
      minutes: 15
    id: forgotten
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: opened
        sequence:
          - action: light.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: light.pantry
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id:
              - closed
              - forgotten
        sequence:
          - action: light.turn_off
            target:
              entity_id: light.pantry

recipes.title: Das Licht wird im Tagesverlauf wärmer
recipes.yaml:
alias: Wärmeres Licht im Tagesverlauf
triggers:
  - trigger: time_pattern
    minutes: "/15"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    after: "06:00:00"
    before: "23:00:00"
actions:
  - variables:
      kelvin: >
        {% set h = now().hour %}
        {{ 3000 if h < 9 else 4000 if h < 17
           else 3000 if h < 20 else 2400 }}
  - repeat:
      for_each:
        - light.living_room
        - light.kitchen
        - light.hallway
      sequence:
        - if:
            - condition: template
              value_template: >
                {{ is_state(repeat.item, 'on') }}
          then:
            - action: light.turn_on
              target:
                entity_id: "{{ repeat.item }}"
              data:
                color_temp_kelvin: "{{ kelvin | int }}"
                transition: 20

recipes.title: Ein Einschlaf-Licht, das langsam ausgeht
recipes.yaml:
alias: Schlafzimmerlicht zum Einschlafen
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: input_button.bedtime
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.bedroom
    data:
      brightness_pct: 5
      transition: 120
  - delay:
      minutes: 3
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: light.bedroom

recipes.title: Rollläden hoch bei Sonnenaufgang, aber nie vor 07:00 Uhr
recipes.yaml:
alias: Rollladen hoch - Sonnenaufgang, nicht vor 07:00
triggers:
  - trigger: sun.sunrise
  - trigger: time
    at: "07:00:00"
conditions:
  - condition: sun.is_up
  - condition: time
    after: "07:00:00"
    weekday:
      - mon
      - tue
      - wed
      - thu
      - fri
actions:
  - action: cover.open_cover
    target:
      entity_id: cover.bedroom_blinds

recipes.title: Ein Hausmodus, der sich selbst aktualisiert
recipes.yaml:
alias: Hausmodus folgt den Personen
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id:
      - person.anna
      - person.ben
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: input_select.house_mode
    state:
      - Home
      - Away
actions:
  - action: input_select.select_option
    target:
      entity_id: input_select.house_mode
    data:
      option: >
        {{ 'Home' if states.person
           | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'home')
           | list | count > 0 else 'Away' }}

recipes.title: Ein Gästemodus, der die „Niemand zu Hause“-Regeln pausiert
recipes.yaml:
alias: Gästemodus ein und aus
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: input_boolean.guest_mode
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: state
            entity_id: input_boolean.guest_mode
            state: "on"
        sequence:
          - action: input_select.select_option
            target:
              entity_id: input_select.house_mode
            data:
              option: Guests
    default:
      - action: input_select.select_option
        target:
          entity_id: input_select.house_mode
        data:
          option: Home

recipes.title: Das Haus anwärmen, wenn du fast da bist
recipes.yaml:
alias: Heizung an, wenn jemand in der Nähe ist
triggers:
  - trigger: zone.entered
    target:
      entity_id:
        - person.anna
        - person.ben
    options:
      zone: zone.near_home
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: input_select.house_mode
    state: Away
  - condition: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.living_room_temperature
    below: 19
actions:
  - action: climate.set_temperature
    target:
      entity_id: climate.living_room
    data:
      temperature: 21
      hvac_mode: heat

recipes.title: Eine Morgenroutine, die einmal am Tag läuft
recipes.yaml:
alias: Guten Morgen - erste Bewegung des Tages
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.kitchen_motion
    to: "on"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    after: "06:00:00"
    before: "10:00:00"
  - condition: template
    value_template: >
      {{ this.attributes.last_triggered is none
         or as_local(this.attributes.last_triggered)
            .date() != now().date() }}
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.kitchen
    data:
      brightness_pct: 70
  - action: cover.open_cover
    target:
      entity_id: cover.kitchen_blinds

recipes.title: Ein anderes Aufwachen an Arbeitstagen und Feiertagen
recipes.yaml:
alias: Weck-Licht nur an Arbeitstagen
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "06:45:00"
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.workday_sensor
    state: "on"
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.bedroom
    data:
      brightness_pct: 25
      color_temp_kelvin: 2700
      transition: 300

recipes.title: Ein Filmmodus, der alles wieder zurückstellt
recipes.yaml:
alias: Filmmodus ein
sequence:
  - action: scene.create
    data:
      scene_id: before_movie
      snapshot_entities:
        - light.living_room
        - light.kitchen
        - cover.living_room_blinds
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: light.kitchen
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.living_room
    data:
      brightness_pct: 10
  - action: cover.close_cover
    target:
      entity_id: cover.living_room_blinds
---
alias: Filmmodus aus
sequence:
  - action: scene.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: scene.before_movie

recipes.title: Ein „Ich gehe“-Skript für Knöpfe, Sprache und Automationen
recipes.yaml:
alias: Haus verlassen
fields:
  lock_door:
    name: Haustür abschließen
    default: true
    selector:
      boolean: {}
sequence:
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: all
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ lock_door | default(true) }}"
    then:
      - action: lock.lock
        target:
          entity_id: lock.front_door
  - action: climate.set_preset_mode
    target:
      entity_id: climate.living_room
    data:
      preset_mode: eco
  - action: input_select.select_option
    target:
      entity_id: input_select.house_mode
    data:
      option: Away

recipes.title: Nur die Leute informieren, die zu Hause sind
recipes.yaml:
alias: Briefkasten geöffnet - Info an alle zu Hause
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.mailbox
    to: "on"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    after: "08:00:00"
    before: "20:00:00"
actions:
  - repeat:
      for_each:
        - person: person.anna
          notify: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
        - person: person.ben
          notify: notify.mobile_app_ben_phone
      sequence:
        - if:
            - condition: template
              value_template: >
                {{ is_state(repeat.item.person, 'home') }}
          then:
            - action: "{{ repeat.item.notify }}"
              data:
                title: Briefkasten
                message: Der Briefkasten wurde geöffnet.

recipes.title: Eine Erinnerung, die so lange nachfragt, bis du abhakst
recipes.yaml:
alias: Mülltonnen - erinnern bis erledigt
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "19:30:00"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    weekday:
      - tue
actions:
  - repeat:
      count: 4
      sequence:
        - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
          data:
            title: Mülltonnen
            message: Tonnen rausgestellt?
            data:
              tag: bins
              actions:
                - action: BINS_DONE
                  title: Erledigt
                - action: BINS_LATER
                  title: In 30 Minuten
        - wait_for_trigger:
            - trigger: event
              event_type: mobile_app_notification_action
              event_data:
                action: BINS_DONE
            - trigger: event
              event_type: mobile_app_notification_action
              event_data:
                action: BINS_LATER
          timeout: "00:30:00"
        - if:
            - condition: template
              value_template: >
                {{ wait.trigger is not none
                   and wait.trigger.event.data.action
                       == 'BINS_DONE' }}
          then:
            - stop: Tonnen erledigt
        - if:
            - condition: template
              value_template: >
                {{ wait.trigger is not none }}
          then:
            - delay:
                minutes: 30

recipes.title: Eine Benachrichtigung, die sich selbst entfernt, wenn das Problem weg ist
recipes.yaml:
alias: Gartentor - warnen, dann löschen
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.garden_gate
    to: "on"
    for:
      minutes: 10
    id: open_long
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.garden_gate
    to: "off"
    id: closed
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: open_long
        sequence:
          - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
            data:
              title: Gartentor
              message: Gartentor seit 10 Minuten offen.
              data:
                tag: garden_gate
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: closed
        sequence:
          - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
            data:
              message: clear_notification
              data:
                tag: garden_gate

recipes.title: Eine Batterie-Nachricht am Sonntag statt zehn Warnungen
recipes.yaml:
alias: Batterie-Übersicht am Sonntag
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "10:00:00"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    weekday:
      - sun
actions:
  - variables:
      low: >
        {% set ns = namespace(items=[]) %}
        {% for s in states.sensor
           if s.attributes.device_class | default('')
              == 'battery'
           and s.state | float(100) < 20 %}
          {% set ns.items = ns.items
             + [s.name ~ ' ' ~ s.state ~ '%'] %}
        {% endfor %}
        {{ ns.items | join(', ') }}
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ low != '' }}"
    then:
      - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
        data:
          title: Batterien unter 20 %
          message: "{{ low }}"

recipes.title: Das Unwichtige gehört in die Glocke
recipes.yaml:
alias: Farn braucht Wasser
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "09:00:00"
    id: check
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.fern_moisture
    above: 40
    id: wet
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: check
          - condition: numeric_state
            entity_id: sensor.fern_moisture
            below: 25
        sequence:
          - action: persistent_notification.create
            data:
              notification_id: fern_dry
              title: Farn
              message: Der Farn ist trocken. Heute gießen.
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: wet
        sequence:
          - action: persistent_notification.dismiss
            data:
              notification_id: fern_dry

recipes.title: Der eine Alarm, der dich wecken darf: eine zu warme Tiefkühltruhe
recipes.yaml:
alias: Tiefkühler zu warm
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.freezer_temperature
    above: -12
    for:
      minutes: 30
actions:
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Tiefkühler
      message: >
        Tiefkühler seit 30 Minuten wärmer
        als -12 Grad. Prüfe Tür und Stecker.
      data:
        push:
          sound:
            name: default
            critical: 1
            volume: 1.0
        ttl: 0
        priority: high

recipes.title: Der Badlüfter folgt der Luftfeuchtigkeit
recipes.yaml:
alias: Badlüfter folgt der Luftfeuchte
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.bathroom_humidity
    above: 70
    id: humid
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.bathroom_humidity
    below: 60
    for:
      minutes: 5
    id: dry
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: humid
        sequence:
          - action: switch.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: switch.bathroom_fan
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: dry
        sequence:
          - action: switch.turn_off
            target:
              entity_id: switch.bathroom_fan

recipes.title: Das Bad vorheizen, aber nur an kalten Morgen
recipes.yaml:
alias: Vorheizen an kalten Morgen
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "05:30:00"
conditions:
  - condition: numeric_state
    entity_id: weather.home
    attribute: temperature
    below: 8
  - condition: state
    entity_id: input_select.house_mode
    state: Home
actions:
  - action: climate.set_temperature
    target:
      entity_id: climate.bathroom
    data:
      temperature: 22
      hvac_mode: heat

recipes.title: Nachts die Heizung absenken, morgens wieder hochfahren
recipes.yaml:
alias: Heizung - Nachtabsenkung
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "22:30:00"
    id: night
  - trigger: time
    at: "06:00:00"
    id: morning
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: night
        sequence:
          - action: climate.set_preset_mode
            target:
              entity_id: climate.living_room
            data:
              preset_mode: eco
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: morning
        sequence:
          - action: climate.set_preset_mode
            target:
              entity_id: climate.living_room
            data:
              preset_mode: home

recipes.title: Das Ladegerät schaltet sich ab, wenn der Akku voll ist
recipes.yaml:
alias: Ladegerät aus, wenn der Akku voll ist
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.ebike_charger_power
    below: 3
    for:
      minutes: 10
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: switch.ebike_charger
    state: "on"
actions:
  - action: switch.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: switch.ebike_charger
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      message: Das E-Bike ist geladen. Der Stecker ist aus.

recipes.title: Jeden Abend eine Zeile zum Stromverbrauch
recipes.yaml:
alias: Strom-Zusammenfassung am Abend
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "21:00:00"
actions:
  - variables:
      kwh: >
        {{ states('sensor.daily_energy')
           | float(0) | round(1) }}
      cost: >
        {{ (states('sensor.daily_energy') | float(0)
            * states('input_number.price_per_kwh')
              | float(0)) | round(2) }}
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Strom heute
      message: >
        {{ kwh }} kWh heute, etwa {{ cost }}
        zu deinem Preis.

recipes.title: Die Spülmaschine laufen lassen, wenn Strom billig ist
recipes.yaml:
alias: Spülmaschine startet bei günstigem Strom
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.electricity_price
    below: input_number.cheap_price_limit
    id: cheap
  - trigger: time
    at: "05:00:00"
    id: deadline
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: input_boolean.dishwasher_ready
    to: "on"
    id: ready
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: input_boolean.dishwasher_ready
    state: "on"
  - condition: template
    value_template: >
      {{ trigger.id == 'deadline'
         or states('sensor.electricity_price')
            | float(99)
            < states('input_number.cheap_price_limit')
              | float(0) }}
actions:
  - action: switch.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: switch.dishwasher_plug
  - action: input_boolean.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: input_boolean.dishwasher_ready

recipes.title: Solar-Überschuss für Warmwasser nutzen
recipes.yaml:
alias: Solar-Überschuss heizt den Boiler
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.grid_power
    below: -1500
    for:
      minutes: 5
    id: surplus
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.grid_power
    above: 100
    for:
      minutes: 5
    id: end
conditions:
  - condition: time
    after: "10:00:00"
    before: "17:00:00"
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: surplus
          - condition: numeric_state
            entity_id: sensor.boiler_temperature
            below: 55
        sequence:
          - action: switch.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: switch.boiler_plug
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: end
        sequence:
          - action: switch.turn_off
            target:
              entity_id: switch.boiler_plug

recipes.title: Ein leeres Haus bewohnt aussehen lassen
recipes.yaml:
alias: Anwesenheitssimulation - Abendlampe
triggers:
  - trigger: sun.sunset
    options:
      offset:
        minutes: 20
      offset_type: after
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: input_boolean.holiday_mode
    state: "on"
actions:
  - delay:
      minutes: "{{ range(0, 25) | random }}"
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.living_room_lamp
    data:
      brightness_pct: 50
  - delay:
      minutes: "{{ range(90, 150) | random }}"
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: light.living_room_lamp

recipes.title: Eine Sirene mit Eintrittsverzögerung und Abbrechen-Knopf
recipes.yaml:
alias: Eingangsalarm mit Abbruchfenster
mode: single
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.front_door
    to: "on"
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: input_boolean.alarm_armed
    state: "on"
actions:
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Haustür
      message: Haustür geöffnet. Sirene in 30 Sekunden.
      data:
        actions:
          - action: ALARM_CANCEL
            title: Das war ich
  - wait_for_trigger:
      - trigger: event
        event_type: mobile_app_notification_action
        event_data:
          action: ALARM_CANCEL
      - trigger: state
        entity_id: input_boolean.alarm_armed
        to: "off"
    timeout: "00:00:30"
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ wait.trigger is none }}"
    then:
      - action: siren.turn_on
        target:
          entity_id: siren.hallway
      - delay:
          minutes: 3
      - action: siren.turn_off
        target:
          entity_id: siren.hallway

recipes.title: Vom Sperrbildschirm aus sehen, wer vor der Tür steht
recipes.yaml:
alias: Klingel - Bild aufs Handy
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.doorbell
    to: "on"
actions:
  - delay:
      seconds: 2
  - repeat:
      for_each:
        - notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
        - notify.mobile_app_ben_phone
      sequence:
        - action: "{{ repeat.item }}"
          data:
            title: Klingel
            message: Jemand hat geklingelt.
            data:
              image: /api/camera_proxy/camera.front_door
              entity_id: camera.front_door

recipes.title: Ein Leck schließt das Hauptwasserventil
recipes.yaml:
alias: Leck - Hauptventil schließen
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id:
      - binary_sensor.kitchen_leak
      - binary_sensor.laundry_leak
      - binary_sensor.bathroom_leak
    to: "on"
actions:
  - action: valve.close_valve
    target:
      entity_id: valve.main_water
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Wasserschaden
      message: Wasser erkannt. Hauptventil geschlossen.
      data:
        tag: leak
        ttl: 0
        priority: high

recipes.title: Rauch erkannt: alle Lichter an und eine laute Nachricht
recipes.yaml:
alias: Rauch - alle Lichter an, Handy-Alarm
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id:
      - binary_sensor.smoke_hallway
      - binary_sensor.smoke_kitchen
    to: "on"
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: all
    data:
      brightness_pct: 100
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Rauch
      message: Rauch im Haus erkannt. Prüfe das Haus.
      data:
        push:
          sound:
            name: default
            critical: 1
            volume: 1.0
        ttl: 0
        priority: high

recipes.title: Frag dein Haus: „Ist jemand zu Hause?“
recipes.yaml:
alias: Assist - ist jemand zu Hause?
triggers:
  - trigger: conversation
    command:
      - Ist jemand zu Hause
      - Ist jemand zuhause
actions:
  - set_conversation_response: >
      {% set home = states.person
         | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'home')
         | map(attribute='name') | list %}
      {% if home %}
        Gerade zu Hause: {{ home | join(' und ') }}.
      {% else %}
        Niemand ist zu Hause.
      {% endif %}

recipes.title: Ein Sprachbefehl mit einer Zahl darin
recipes.yaml:
alias: Assist - Lerntimer in Minuten
triggers:
  - trigger: conversation
    command:
      - stelle den Lerntimer auf {minutes} Minuten
actions:
  - action: timer.start
    target:
      entity_id: timer.study_timer
    data:
      duration: "{{ trigger.slots.minutes | int * 60 }}"
  - set_conversation_response: >
      Lerntimer auf
      {{ trigger.slots.minutes }} Minuten gestellt.

recipes.title: Ein „Essen ist fertig“-Knopf für jeden Lautsprecher
recipes.yaml:
alias: Essensruf
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: input_button.dinner_call
actions:
  - action: assist_satellite.announce
    target:
      entity_id:
        - assist_satellite.kitchen
        - assist_satellite.living_room
    data:
      message: Das Essen ist fertig.
      preannounce: true

recipes.title: Eine Montagsliste von allem, was verstummt ist
recipes.yaml:
alias: Montagsliste nicht verfügbarer Entitäten
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "09:00:00"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    weekday:
      - mon
actions:
  - variables:
      gone: >
        {{ states
           | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'unavailable')
           | map(attribute='entity_id')
           | list }}
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ gone | count > 0 }}"
    then:
      - action: persistent_notification.create
        data:
          notification_id: unavailable_report
          title: Nicht verfügbare Entitäten
          message: >
            {{ gone | count }} Entitäten nicht verfügbar:
            {{ gone[:15] | join(', ') }}

recipes.title: Von einem fehlgeschlagenen oder fehlenden Backup erfahren
recipes.yaml:
alias: Backup-Problem
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: event.backup_automatic_backup
    id: event
  - trigger: time
    at: "09:30:00"
    id: age
conditions:
  - condition: template
    value_template: >
      {% if trigger.id == 'event' %}
        {{ trigger.to_state.attributes.event_type
           == 'failed' }}
      {% else %}
        {% set id = 'sensor.backup_last_' ~
                    'successful_automatic_backup' %}
        {{ (now() - states(id) | as_datetime(
              now() - timedelta(days=99))).days
           >= 2 }}
      {% endif %}
actions:
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Backup
      message: >
        Das letzte automatische Backup ist fehlgeschlagen
        oder älter als zwei Tage.
        Siehe Einstellungen > System > Backups.

recipes.title: Eine Samstagsnotiz über wartende Updates, ohne automatisches Installieren
recipes.yaml:
alias: Update-Übersicht am Samstag
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "10:00:00"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    weekday:
      - sat
actions:
  - variables:
      waiting: >
        {{ states.update
           | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on')
           | map(attribute='name') | list }}
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ waiting | count > 0 }}"
    then:
      - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
        data:
          title: Updates warten
          message: >
            {{ waiting | join(', ') }}.
            Erst ein Backup machen, dann unter
            Einstellungen > System > Updates aktualisieren.

recipes.title: Notiz führen, wie lange das Internet weg war
recipes.yaml:
alias: Internetausfall-Bericht
mode: single
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.router_ping
    to: "off"
    for:
      minutes: 3
actions:
  - variables:
      since: "{{ trigger.to_state.last_changed }}"
  - wait_for_trigger:
      - trigger: state
        entity_id: binary_sensor.router_ping
        to: "on"
    timeout: "12:00:00"
  - action: persistent_notification.create
    data:
      title: Internet war weg
      message: >
        Ausfall ab
        {{ as_local(as_datetime(since))
           .strftime('%H:%M') }},
        für etwa
        {{ ((now() - as_datetime(since))
            .total_seconds() / 60)
           | round(0) | int }} Minuten.

recipes.title: Von einem neuen Fehler im Protokoll erfahren, höchstens einmal pro Stunde
recipes.yaml:
alias: Home Assistant hat einen Fehler protokolliert
mode: single
triggers:
  - trigger: event
    event_type: system_log_event
    event_data:
      level: ERROR
actions:
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Home-Assistant-Fehler
      message: >
        {{ trigger.event.data.name }}:
        {{ (trigger.event.data.message | first)
           | string | truncate(150) }}
  - delay:
      hours: 1
